phase3_findings.description: Claim: the #313/#1773/#1911 harness runs the extracted step body as `bash -c "$R313_INJ_BODY"` without the runner's -eo pipefail, so the set -e swallow property the new comment guards against is not exercised.
The warn-jq malformed-input path is untested; the deny guard (same .env // {}) refuses a non-object .env first, so the warn jq never sees a malformed shape (near-unreachable by construction).

fix_decisions.claim_text: harness runs the step body without -eo pipefail, so set -e is not exercised
fix_decisions.evidence: The inject step's own run: block begins with `set -euo pipefail`, and the YAML extraction includes that first line in $R313_INJ_BODY, so `bash -c "$R313_INJ_BODY"` executes under set -euo pipefail. Premise is factually wrong; set -e IS exercised. Independently confirmed by the blinded shadow pass. Residual (a wrapping refactor passes every #1911 assertion) is true only because the jq-failure path is unreachable behind the deny guard (the below-threshold Suggestion).
